root_cause.text: An ABBA lock ordering violation between orphan dir inode_lock and ip_alloc_sem in ocfs2_dio_end_io_write and ocfs2_unlink, where ocfs2_dio_end_io_write takes ip_alloc_sem before orphan dir inode_lock, while ocfs2_unlink takes them in the opposite order.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly describes the two lock chains (unlink: orphan dir inode_lock -> ip_alloc_sem; dio_end_io_write: ip_alloc_sem -> orphan dir inode_lock) and the resulting deadlock scenario. The patch resolves this by moving ocfs2_del_inode_from_orphan (which acquires orphan dir inode_lock) out of the ip_alloc_sem critical section, so that the order in dio_end_io_write becomes orphan dir lock before ip_alloc_sem, matching the order in unlink.
